services.name: Whale Watching Tours
services.desc: From November to May, the majestic Kohola or humpback whale, can be seen off Kauai’s shorelines. These gentle giants come to the warm Hawaiian waters every year to breed and give birth to new calves. Schedule a tour to the best spots to observe whales surfacing, tail slapping, or blowing spouts in the air. Join us for a 2 hours ride along Kauai’s shore. Learn about Humpback whales. Encounter these gentle giants and playful dolphins eye to eye. Drinks and light snacks
